\newcommand{\PaperTitle}{Isosyll: Always Listening, Barely Computing}
\newcommand{\PaperDescriptor}{Bit-Exact Streaming Speech Recognition on One CPU Core}

\newcommand{\AbsAccuracy}{On the 730-utterance LibriSpeech DEV panel, \ultra{} v3.0.0 (final, seg.) scores 5.06\% pooled WER (3.25\% dev-clean, 7.65\% dev-other), ranking 8th of 17 complete-panel systems (beating 8 of 15 public comparators (including streaming Zipformer INT8 at 5.25\%)); \ultra{} v3.0.0 (live) on the exact same INT8 weights scores 6.85\% pooled. On full LibriSpeech DEV (5,567 utt), final text reaches 5.48\% pooled (2.92\% clean / 8.20\% other; live 7.45\%). Larger models score lower at higher CPU cost on their respective timing hosts (3.56\% for Nemotron 560\,ms and 3.36\% for Parakeet TDT v3 (onnx-asr, offline)).}% [exploratory] sentence
\newcommand{\AbsParity}{Per-row centred INT8 with exact int32 accumulation and portable log-mel matches FP32 PyTorch on full DEV (5,567 utterances) within $-$0.003\,pp (95\% bounds $-$0.033 to +0.028\,pp), with repeatable, batch-invariant execution.}% [exploratory] sentence
\newcommand{\AbsSpeed}{One live stream (\ultra{} v3.0.0 (live)) uses 3.4\% of one quiet Zen~2 core (29.1$\times$ real time (2.0$\times$ streaming Zipformer INT8, fastest in the quiet full-panel H1 cohort)) and 74\,MB peak RAM (smallest quiet-H1 footprint); \ultra{} v3.0.0 (final, seg.) runs at 14.2$\times$ real time and 725\,MB RAM (median final-text delay 211\,ms after endpoint), within 2\% of streaming Zipformer INT8's single-core speed (14.2$\times$ utterance-segmented vs. 14.5$\times$ streaming).}% [exploratory] sentence
\newcommand{\AbsWatts}{Unpaced active core power on quiet H1 is 0.344\,W per stream for \ultra{} v3.0.0 (live) and 0.720\,W (1.64\,W package) for \ultra{} v3.0.0 (final, seg.), against 0.591\,W for Zipformer INT8, 1.077\,W for Moonshine Tiny, 1.711\,W for Parakeet TDT v3 (sherpa-onnx, offline) and 4.513\,W for Nemotron 560\,ms (quiet 73-clip timing) (CPU domain only, not wall power).}% [exploratory] sentence
